name: cyphersolver
description: My attempts to read unsolved ciphers from history

paragraphs: An informal benchmark of frontier AI models on historically "unsolved" ciphers, as much a hobby as a measurement. Most of the work is by Claude (Opus 5 and 5.5, some Fable 5.1); a few results came from outside contributors using other models. Each target's profile.json records which model did what, and what it was given. The first targets came from three standard lists: S. Tomokiyo's Unsolved Historical Ciphers, Klaus Schmeh's Top 50 unsolved encrypted messages, and Elonka Dunin's famous unsolved codes. Since mid-September 2026 most come from this project's own catalogue of undeciphered…
features: Website: — hub, priority queue, and formal write-ups (source in docs/).
Solved, catalogued: SOLVEDCATALOGUE.md — every item solved, read or partly read, the method that broke it, and where the AI did the work.
Solved, ranked: SOLVEDRANKING.md — the finished targets in one table, scored by difficulty, historical weight, novelty, research effort, profile and verification.

Catalogue of open targets: CATALOGUE.md · site page — undeciphered letters and series absent from the standard lists, scored for importance, solvability and difficulty. Generated from catalogue.json; a target leaves it…

Per-target record: each folder under targets/ has a NOTES.md (sources, dead ends, what is established and what is inferred) and a profile.json (the fixed-field record behind the paper; profile.schema.json).
